# Function isRoutedAgent

  * isRoutedAgent(obj: unknown): obj is [RoutedAgent](../classes/RoutedAgent.html)

Type guard to check if an object is an instance of RoutedAgent.

#### Parameters

The object to check.

#### Returns obj is [RoutedAgent](../classes/RoutedAgent.html)
